name: Shared grounding-pack emission - one ranked map, frozen, injected into every lane
description: Blueprint 85 of 96 (design BP-DOC-04). Build ONE ranked, token-budgeted map of a code tree and inject it into every lane of a fan-out, instead of letting each agent rediscover the same files. Mechanism: reference-graph centrality ranking under a hard token budget, then a FREEZE - once the first lane launches the pack is immutable, because editing it mid-run leaves contradictory instructions live in sibling prompts. Failure semantics are deliberately DEGRADE-LOUDLY rather than fail-fast: a fan-out without a pack is merely more expensive, so a generator failure must not block the work it was meant to cheapen.

repo_root.description: ABSOLUTE repo root. The generator's documented default is repo-relative and dies with [Errno 2] from any other cwd - passing the absolute form IS the wrapper this blueprint exists to add.

token_budget.description: Hard ceiling for the emitted pack. A pack that blows the per-turn budget costs more than the rediscovery it prevents.

out_path.description: Where the pack is written. Every lane prompt inlines THIS file, not a paraphrase of it.

ranking_source.description: symbol-scan-pagerank works anywhere; lsp-reference-edges is better where a language server is available because the edges are real references rather than name matches

manual_must_include.description: Paths that must appear regardless of rank. Centrality favours central code and can bury the unusual file that actually matters - this is the documented escape hatch for that weakness.

expected_lane_count.description: Lanes the pack will be injected into. Below 8 the pack rarely pays for itself; that threshold is the recommended-default boundary, not a hard rule.

pack-generator.description: Runs the ranking generator with absolute paths and writes the pack under the token budget

omission-reviewer.description: Reads the ranking for obvious omissions - the file a human would expect and centrality buried

routes.reason: spotting the buried-but-important file is judgement; the generation itself is mostly mechanical

stages.title: Run the ranking generator with an ABSOLUTE root

work_unit.title: Emit a centrality-ranked, token-budgeted grounding pack for the tree
work_unit.question_or_target: Rank the tree's symbols by reference-graph centrality (or by LSP reference edges where available), then emit the top-ranked slice that fits token_budget, with every path in manual_must_include forced in. Invoke the generator with the ABSOLUTE repo_root.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the ranking is mechanical; deciding what to truncate at the budget boundary is not

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the literal generator command line showing the absolute root, the measured token count of the emitted pack, and the rank score of the lowest-ranked included symbol
tests_required: both-states control: invoking the generator from a DIFFERENT cwd with a repo-relative root must produce [Errno 2], and the absolute form must succeed from that same cwd - a wrapper that succeeds in both cases proves nothing about the defect it claims to fix
a pack exceeding token_budget must FAIL rather than be truncated silently
every manual_must_include path must appear in the emitted pack
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the omission reviewer reads the ranking independently, without being shown the generator's own confidence
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8501 emitted only when the pack exists, is within budget, and contains every must-include path; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8501 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: one retry with the absolute root if the first attempt hit [Errno 2]; a second [Errno 2] means the wrapper is wrong and the run degrades rather than retrying a third time

stages.title: The wrapper is the fix - prove it was used

work_unit.title: Review the ranking for the important file that centrality buried
work_unit.question_or_target: Read the emitted pack and the tree structure and name any path a competent reader of this task would expect and the ranking omitted. For each, say WHY centrality missed it (recently added, few inbound references, configuration rather than code).

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: this is the one genuinely non-mechanical step: PageRank cannot know which unusual file matters for THIS task

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per omission the path, its inbound reference count, and the reason the ranking scored it low; an omission claim with no reference count is an opinion
tests_required: a file with zero inbound references that is nonetheless the task's entry point must be flagged
the review must NOT simply re-list the top-ranked entries - a review whose findings are a subset of the pack has found nothing
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: none - this stage IS the review; its own output is checked only for the re-listing failure mode
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8502 emitted only when the review either names at least one omission with a reference count or states explicitly that it found none and how far down the ranking it looked; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8502 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry - a second pass by the same reviewer over the same pack is not an independent signal

stages.title: Within budget, with every must-include present
FREEZE - record the hash, then never edit it again this run

work_unit.title: Fold the reviewed omissions in, hash the pack, and mark it frozen
work_unit.question_or_target: Add the reviewed omissions, re-check the token budget, hash the final bytes, and record the hash as the frozen pack identity. After this point any edit is a new pack with a new hash, not a revision of this one.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: folding omissions in without breaching the budget is a trade-off decision

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the sha256 of the frozen bytes, the final token count, and the list of omissions folded in with what was dropped to make room
tests_required: editing the pack after the freeze record must produce a hash mismatch that any lane can detect
folding omissions in must not push the token count over budget
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reader who recomputes the hash from the pack bytes
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8503 emitted only when the frozen hash is recorded and the final token count is within budget; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8503 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: one retry after dropping the lowest-ranked entries to make room; a second budget breach means the omission set is too large and the run degrades with the pack it has

stages.title: Frozen before the first lane launches

estimate.measurement_source: 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.md#BP-DOC-04 and fan-out-contract A11 - the measured waste it removes: 16 of 25 agents read the same source file, 13 of 25 the same doc, one agent re-read one path 22 times; ONE grounding agent is estimated to remove 60-90 tool calls in a 39-agent workflow

impact.blast_radius: writes only under command-center/grounding/**; its real reach is indirect - every lane prompt in the calling fan-out inlines the pack, so a wrong pack misleads N lanes at once

derived_from.credit: owner - PageRank over symbol references sized to a token budget
owner - the measured rediscovery waste and the freeze rule

rollback_to: tools/repomap@current invoked manually with an absolute root

x_extensions.mechanism: centrality ranking under a hard token budget, one human-judgement omission review, then an immutable FREEZE identified by hash. The freeze is the mechanism that prevents mid-run split-brain across lanes; the budget is what stops the cure costing more than the disease.

not_a_duplicate_because.vs_skill-plugin-portfolio-stocktake: that measures what the HARNESS loads and prunes it against a context budget; this ranks a CODE TREE for injection into prompts and prunes nothing
not_a_duplicate_because.vs_memory-temporal-validity-curation: that maintains semantic memory across sessions and verifies by recall order; this is a single-run, frozen, per-tree artifact that is deliberately discarded when the run ends

contraindications: NOT for a single-agent task - the pack pays for itself only across lanes
NOT for a tree small enough to read directly
NOT for a run already in flight - a pack produced mid-run leaves contradictory instructions live

benchmark_cases.given: the generator invoked from a cwd other than the repo root
benchmark_cases.expect: the repo-relative form raises [Errno 2] and the absolute form succeeds from the SAME cwd

benchmark_cases.given: a 10-lane fan-out run with and without the pack
benchmark_cases.expect: a measurable reduction in duplicate reads of the same path; the design's 60-90 figure is an estimate from a 39-agent run, not a measurement of this workflow

benchmark_cases.given: a task entry point with zero inbound references
benchmark_cases.expect: flagged by the omission review and folded in at freeze time

omission_review.why_missed: few inbound references but it owns the stopping-expression grammar every lane will touch

worked_examples.terminal_state: SUCCESS:BPW-8503 - pack frozen at 5,904 tokens of a 6,000 budget, 1 omission folded in, 1 low-rank entry dropped
worked_examples.note: The dropped entry is recorded rather than silently discarded: a budget trade-off nobody can see is indistinguishable from a bug.

unverified: The 60-90 tool-call saving is an ESTIMATE quoted from the design card for a 39-agent workflow; it is UNVERIFIED for this estate and for this workflow. Settling experiment = the two-arm tool-call comparison benchmark case, run on one real 10-lane fan-out with the pack and one without.

That centrality ranking is the RIGHT ranking is UNVERIFIED - the omission review exists precisely because the ranking is known to bury unusual-but-important files. No measurement here establishes how often that happens. Settling experiment = count folded-in omissions across ten runs; a high rate would mean the ranking, not the review, needs replacing.
